notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Yesterday I released a small update with hot fixes of Softlock with the need to restart the scene.
And some green zones visibility improvements

Today's update contains bug fixes and improvements within the game, such as clearer hints and explanations of further actions.

The full list of changes is below:

Fixes:
- Fixes to customer animations while eating
- Fixes for NPC interaction with some doors
- Fixes for NPCs getting stuck in doors
- Fix for multiple Softlocks in different scenes leading to scene restarts
- Fix in-game menus not working in some scenes
- Fix for visual incompleteness of a task in notepad
- Fix for the possibility of infinite restart of a cutscene
- Fix for infinite phone conversations
- Fix some issues in English localization
- Fixes for some other smaller visual problems

Improvements:
- Added new character replicas to help you understand the following tasks and make it easier to get through some difficult locations, as well as getting an alternate ending.

--------------------------------------
Most of visual problems are fixed, I plan to release the first batch of localizations tomorrow.

Thank you so much to everyone who has played the game or wants to play and just waiting for localization - I really appreciate it.

Also a huge thank you to everyone who writes and supports me, sends bugs and helps to make the game better.

See you tomorrow!

- Denis

notes.title: Devlog: the finish line
notes.notes:
Hey, everybody!

[h3]HorrorGameAward Summer Showcase[/h3]

Yesterday was HorrorGameAward's Summer Showcase and the start of the HorrorGameAward themed sale, True Nightmare - Roadside Cafe participated in both events!

In less than 24 hours, 80 people added the game to their wishlist and we're closing in on a very significant number. (We'll probably reach it this week and I'll share this great news).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/4ca7d6830b6fa694a0710615b236c1db9c72729f.png[/img]

[h3]Trailer and release date[/h3]

A new trailer was unveiled at the event, and the game's release date was announced (I'll do a separate post about the release later in the week).

The trailer showed new locations, some previously undisclosed moments from the game (brutal, as some people said).

You can watch it on my Youtube page and leave a comment - it helps the game to be promoted and gives the trailer a chance to be seen!

[previewyoutube=bXwhovRKCl0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Progress on development[/h3]

I've been actively working on both new locations and cutscenes recently, some of which you can see in the trailer.

The dialogue system has also been improved. Many of them are optional, some of them can be opened under certain conditions, some of them can open new opportunities.

In general in the game you can explore different places, find clues, pieces of history and interesting things. It will be liked by all those who like to look under every stone and in every trash can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/557b237e57c69422654d5ae192e3eec7cd6138f2.png[/img]

[h3]Future plans[/h3]

I plan to finalise some things in the near future and will open registration for beta testing very soon. Anyone can register - stay tuned!

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you all for your support - more cool news very soon!

- Denis

notes.title: A legendary comeback
notes.notes:
Hello to everyone who is reading this!

Haven't heard from me in a long time. There were reasons for that, but now everything is fine and work continues! And now I will tell you about everything that happened during these months and what to expect.

[h2]Art is a tricky thing[/h2]

Back in November, I set out to change the current capsules and logo. I wanted to provide streamers and media with really high quality artwork for them to use.

I found a great artist (judging by his work and reviews), we agreed on everything. I transferred the prepayment and the work began! The first sketches of the 2 pieces I ordered were great and the one provided in color was also unparalleled. Half of the work took almost two months to complete, but I was willing to wait as the quality was worth it.

However... After providing me with screenshots of the work in progress.... silence. I have been trying for months to get some sort of response, but I have not received any more replies to messages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/78cca3c72d5a2afacc66b32a31cbdcf4af3e7665.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/255d73f8eb43515dfc76f1ae541c4e0cecf0a632.jpg[/img]

Thus I was left with only two pictures. One of which was in color. Perhaps I will use one of them, because despite the whole situation, I will not deny that the quality of work is top-notch. So in February I made the decision to stop waiting for a response and found a new artist. I hope you will see his work very soon! And below I will attach the two images that I have left after 4 months of cooperation.

Perhaps the man had his own problems, so he couldn't finish the job. At least I know he's alive, heh. After all, he's been playing games steadily on Steam, which can be said about his page. So I hope he's doing well, and I'll move on to the next topic.

[h2]I'm something of an Artist myself[/h2]

In an attempt to somehow get out of the predicament I made some attempts to make a new logo for the game. Which would be unique and would look quality. Below I attach the last version I made. What do you think of it? Especially in relation to the current one. (I'm not a super photoshop expert, so don't judge me harshly).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/96ebdf739a24b361d1bb955c8e161ff5eab8c4bb.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

Having studied a lot of feedback after going through the demo (many thanks to everyone who played and who shared their opinions). I've made some changes and improvements, which I'll talk about below.

[h3]Notebook[/h3]

The tasks are in the corner of the screen? The instructions are somewhere in the computer and you have to run to them all the time? What did the character just say? Uncomfortable. Not immersive. Solution? Notebook!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/98a28b19b54400813f033d90691d1d648698d678.gif[/img]

Set tasks for the day, tag customer orders, and write down your thoughts. And it's always at your fingertips.

[h3]Dialogs[/h3]

There are more of them. They're hiding something. Not everyone will find what to say or what to ask. 

Hidden dialog options appeared. They open up if you do something, inspect something, or talk to someone else. Some will appear in the story, but some you can only unlock if you're careful, savvy, and of course luck (who knows what (or who) might be hiding in a random trash can).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/03156b9f7cdcbea4c8d35ec5d024ac3a07d0ca20.gif[/img]

What can you discover and where will it take you?

[h3]Other[/h3]

In general, I add a lot of points of interest, things to look at, and just places to get in and explore in a location. 

Don't forget about the new location: Trailer Park. Where our new heroine will live and meet a lot of interesting events.

New characters, as well as those already familiar from the prologue. Cutscenes will also be, I'm working on them diligently. Animations for actions (mopping floors is so fun, yea).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/fb98716433ec3ec254cc22d826a336d8b69f8e1d.gif[/img]

In general, the work is in full swing. I apologize for such a long pause in the news, I will try to deliver them monthly on a stable basis.


-------------------------------------------

Subscribe to the media to not miss weekly updates on development progress and participate in interesting discussions.

I want to thank everyone who is participating or just waiting for the project to come out. Happy Spring to everyone and have a great weekend!

- Denis

notes.title: A spurt or a breakthrough?
notes.notes:
In this devlog I will summarize the results of the festival on Steam, talk about localization, media and next steps in the development of the project.
	
[h3]Steam Demo Fest[/h3]

The demo prologue of our game took part in the festival and showed incredible results!
- 3000 Wishlists
- 1600 unique users
- A lot of positive feedback in X, Discord and on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/f38860126037ed1261a6cb95e88ba0df3c1f8ad7.png[/img]

I didn't even think the game could perform this well and get people to like it so much! Thank you all so much for your participation and support! It was incredible!

[h3]Localization[/h3]

In recent updates I added support for 12 new languages!
Now you can play the demo-prologue in English, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazil) ,German, French, Japanese, Korean, Ukrainian, Polish, Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/25986a8837d458df6c0bee0005d6e5b1284ba2d8.gif[/img]

To maintain this language diversity I developed my own localization system, which permeates all game systems and allows you to update and add new languages just by changing text files and clicking a couple of buttons. It took a couple weeks and a little more nerve to get it all working.

[h3]Media[/h3]

Since the release of the demo-version a large number of streamers and youtubers have managed to make a review and play it. We also got our own categories on Twitch and Youtube!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/44d751913f67a98e1f0c35521bcc8703f32af047.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/e7443e8be6dcadd573ccf6730240d942bf4dff62.png[/img]

If you know any streamers or content creators who might be interested in the game - please email me or contact via Discord, I will contact them and maybe they will see the prologue too!

[h3]Next steps[/h3]

Right now, I'm tight on the development of the main game. Releasing the prologue has provided incredibly valuable experience regarding how people play the game, what they are interested in, and what they would like to see in the full game. I've gotten a lot of feedback and suggestions for improvement, for which I am extremely grateful!


And a small gif with a new location in progress:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/2ca06b056a78cfdac9d0c9010b774b001fb91c6d.gif[/img]

-------------------------------------

Thank you all for your support and that's it for now. See you later!

BTW have you joined our Discord channel?
[url=https://discord.gg/4mtVWQkg2e]JOIN DISCORD[/url]

notes.title: Devlog: Do you like burgers?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This is the first devlog and today I'm going to talk about what we have to do during our hard working day as a waitress and what we have to feed our dear customers (yes, there will be burgers too). More specifically, we're going to break down our kitchen.

[h2]Manager[/h2]

At the start of the work day, we'll be greeted by our favorite (or not so favorite) boss. Don't be late for work (he doesn't like it much).

In general the dialog system has been improved, more effects have been added and everything looks much more pleasant. Enjoy your conversations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/3e2375259fea6a37240b97b24ca21e712ca3a076.gif[/img]

[h2]Food[/h2]

What's on the menu today? Our favorite burgers of course, as well as pizza, fries and drinks to choose from!

The kitchen was redesigned: more equipment and interaction elements, more items on the menu. Variety of food - customers are satisfied!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/2285c5a771597a25f60d468fda084cf8fdd46276.gif[/img]

[h2]Computer stuff[/h2]

We have such a modern cafe that we even have a computer for accounting. How you use it is your choice. It's night, no one's here, or maybe...

A computer has been added with various features: do accounting or play games at work, write notes, watch videos. Who knows what you will find among the information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101407/b654e91bbd1b1bd5d067cbbb9e17b762b94ab5ad.gif[/img]

============================================

That's it for today, but don't be sad, I'll be sharing some more important updates this week, so stay tuned) Devlogs will be regular and come out about once a month.

To keep up to date with all the news - subscribe to my [url=https://x.com/deni_sele]X(Twitter)[/url]. There you will be able to know faster about all the news and updates. 

And of course add the game to your Wishlist!

Until next time!
